messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.30-4
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.30-4) has been released at its web site 
(http://www.rqtl.org) and will be on CRAN shortly.

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a list of changes.  The major
changes are listed below.

As always, I'd appreciate hearing any suggestions or comments or 
complaints. 

Karl Broman 

------

Major changes:

  Revised parallel code (in scanone, scantwo, mqmpermutation, and
  mqmscanall) to use a different function for Windows, as mclapply()
  doesn't work there.
